description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act No. 43 of 2007
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which establishes a regulatory framework for commodity levies. It modifies the application of an existing regulation (waiving a portion of the levy) for specific imported fish products under certain conditions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
